description.name: energy-vs-force per-structure data
description.purpose: citable per-structure (dE, max|F|) data the energy-vs-force figures import (instead of re-reading AGOX DBs)
caveats: fmax is the STORED force after the AGOX evaluator's single DFT step (optimizer_run_kwargs={'fmax':0.05,'steps':1}); P-doped leaves are not force-converged (0.7-40 eV/A)
dE evaluated per leaf against that leaf's own global minimum
